dict.string: AETHER-OS looks for Markdown vaults and opens the notes and projects you keep in your Documents folder.
AETHER-OS opens the notes, projects and files you keep on your Desktop.
AETHER-OS opens files and plugin packages you downloaded when you choose them.
AETHER-OS opens vaults, backups and sync folders on external drives when you choose them.
AETHER-OS opens vaults, backups and sync folders on network drives when you choose them.
